prompt_metadata.title: E-Fix Hub — Admin Dashboard Reverse Engineering & Product Lifecycle Management
prompt_metadata.project_type: Django Web Application (Circular Economy E-Waste Platform)

project_context.description: E-Fix Hub is a circular economy platform where customers upload e-waste items, which are then collected by agents, restored by mechanics, and sold as refurbished products through an integrated online store (similar to Amazon/Flipkart). The admin has full oversight of the entire lifecycle.

objectives.title: Admin Product Management Grid (Manage Products Page)
objectives.description: The admin should see ALL e-waste items in a comprehensive grid/card layout. Each card must display strategic data about the item at a glance.

card_must_display: Current lifecycle status with color-coded badge (Pending, Approved, With Agent, In Repair, Repaired, Listed for Sale, Sold Out)
Category label (Mobile, Laptop, TV, Appliance, Other)
Current physical location of the item (User Origin / Agent Transit / Mechanic Workshop / Central Hub / Store Inventory)
Active entity — who currently has custody (assigned agent name OR assigned mechanic name)
Key timestamp — when it was logged into the system
Sold/Live status with date if applicable
action_buttons_per_card: Inspect — Opens the detailed item view (admin_item_detail)
Approve — Only visible if status is 'Pending'
Dispatch Agent — Only visible if status is 'Approved' (to assign a pickup agent)
Assign Engineer — Only visible if status is 'Collected' (to assign a mechanic)
Market Inject — Only visible if restoration is complete (to publish to refurbished store)
requirements.filtering: Items should be filterable or categorized by status groups (Pending, Approved, With Agent, In Repair, Repaired, Sold Out)
requirements.empty_state: Professional empty state message when no items exist in the pipeline

objectives.title: Detailed Item View (Item Detail Page)
objectives.description: When admin clicks on a product card (Inspect button), they should see a FULL 360-degree view of that item with all strategic intelligence.

primary_asset_data: Item image with category badge overlay
Current lifecycle phase with color-coded status badge
Condition description (e.g., Broken screen, No power)
Discovery district / location where item was found
Initial log timestamp (when it was first uploaded)

lifecycle_timeline.description: A visual vertical timeline showing every stage of the item's journey with exact timestamps. Completed stages should have colored/glowing dots, pending stages should be dimmed.

nodal_management.description: Two side-by-side panels for assigning people to this item.

panels.shows: Currently assigned agent name with avatar initial, OR 'No agent dispatched yet'
panels.action_button: Dispatch Agent — visible only when status is 'Approved'

panels.shows: Currently assigned mechanic/engineer name with avatar initial, OR 'Engineering node not yet established'
panels.action_button: Assign Engineer — visible only when status is 'Collected'

restoration_blueprint.description: Detailed engineering data about the restoration process.
data_points: Item description / field notes from the customer

marketplace_deployment.description: If the item has been converted to a Product and published to the store, show marketplace data.
when_published: Order transmission logs — list of all orders for this product with buyer name, date, and delivery status
when_not_published: Message: 'Awaiting Nodal Maturation — This asset is currently in active restoration'
If restoration is complete: show 'Initiate Market Injection' button that links to publish_product URL

objectives.title: Status Categorization System
objectives.description: Items must be categorized through their entire lifecycle with these specific status phases.

status_phases.description: Customer has uploaded the item. Awaiting admin review.
Admin has approved the item for collection.
A logistics agent has been assigned to pick up this item.
status_phases.location: In Transit (Agent has or is going to collect)

status_phases.description: Agent has physically collected the item from the customer.
status_phases.location: In Transit to Mechanic or Hub

status_phases.description: Item is at the mechanic's workshop for restoration.
Mechanic is actively working on restoring this item. Progress percentage is being tracked.
Mechanic has finished restoration. Item is ready for retrieval or direct publishing.
status_phases.location: Mechanic Workshop (ready for pickup) or Central Hub

status_phases.description: Item has been fully repaired and is at the central hub.
Item has been converted to a Product and published in the refurbished store.
Item has been purchased by a customer. Lifecycle complete.

objectives.title: Timestamp Tracking (Full Lifecycle Audit Trail)
objectives.description: Every major event in the item's lifecycle MUST be recorded with a precise date and time.

timestamp_fields.event: Admin approves the item for collection
Agent physically collects the item from customer

timestamp_fields.type: manual (set when repair is marked complete)

timestamp_fields.event: Admin publishes the item as a Product in the refurbished store
Customer purchases the product from the store

objectives.title: Refurbished Store (Customer-Facing Marketplace)
objectives.description: A professional e-commerce-style store (like Amazon/Flipkart) where customers can browse and purchase restored items.

product_card_must_display: Status badge: 'Ready for Market' (available) OR 'Asset Liquidated' / 'Sold Out' (sold)
'Secure Unit' purchase button (disabled if sold out)
requirements.filtering: Category-based filtering tabs (All, Mobile, Laptop, TV, Appliance, Other)
requirements.sold_items: Sold out items should be visually distinct (greyed out, grayscale, non-clickable purchase button)

objectives.title: Assignment Workflows
objectives.description: Admin must be able to assign items to agents and mechanics from both the dashboard and the detail view.

workflows.action: Admin selects an available, verified agent to collect the item from customer
workflows.result: Item status changes to 'Assigned to Agent', agent gets notification

workflows.action: Admin selects a verified mechanic to restore the item
workflows.result: Item status changes to 'Assigned to Mechanic', mechanic gets notification

workflows.trigger: Item restoration is complete (status is 'Restoration Complete' or 'Repaired' or 'Collected from Mechanic')
workflows.action: Admin sets a price and publishes the item as a Product in the store
workflows.result: Product is created, item status changes to 'Converted to Product', published_at timestamp is set

objectives.title: UI/UX Design Standards
objectives.description: All interfaces must follow the established industrial/tactical design language of E-Fix Hub.

color_palette.accent: Emerald green (for primary actions and success states)
color_palette.neutral: Slate grays (for backgrounds, borders, secondary text)

design_guidelines.typography: Bold, uppercase, italic industrial fonts with tracking-widest/tight
design_guidelines.card_style: Glass cards with border-white/5, bg-white/5 backgrounds, rounded-2xl

key_fields.title: CharField(max_length=255)
key_fields.category: CharField(choices: Mobile, Laptop, TV, Appliance, Other)

key_fields.status: CharField(choices: Pending, Assigned, Picked Up, Out for Delivery, Delivered, Cancelled)

validation_checklist: ✅ Admin can view all items in a grid at /admin-panel/products/
✅ Each card shows: title, status badge, category, progress bar, location, entity, timestamp
✅ Admin can click 'Inspect' to see full item detail at /admin-panel/items/<id>/
✅ Detail view shows lifecycle timeline with 6 stages and timestamps
✅ Detail view shows assigned agent and mechanic with assignment buttons
✅ Detail view shows restoration progress and engineering data
✅ Detail view shows marketplace data if published, or publish button if ready
✅ Statuses are categorized: Pending, Approved, With Agent, In Repair, Repaired, Listed, Sold Out
✅ All lifecycle timestamps are captured: created_at, approved_at, collected_at, restored_at, published_at, sold_at
✅ Refurbished store shows products with category, condition, price, sold status
✅ Sold items are visually distinct and non-purchasable
✅ PROJECT_SYSTEM_EXPLANATION.md is updated with full documentation

instructions_for_ai_agent.context: You are working on the E-Fix Hub Django project. The admin dashboard at /admin-panel/products/ needs comprehensive reverse engineering capabilities for managing e-waste items through their complete lifecycle.
primary_goals: 1. Ensure the admin product management grid displays all strategic telemetry for every item
2. Ensure the item detail view provides 360-degree intelligence with lifecycle timeline and assignment controls
3. Ensure items are categorized by lifecycle status (Pending → Approved → With Agent → In Repair → Repaired → Listed → Sold Out)
4. Ensure all lifecycle timestamps are captured and displayed (upload time, approval time, collection time, restoration time, publication time, sale time)
5. Ensure the refurbished store allows customers to browse and purchase restored items
6. Ensure assignment workflows work correctly (assign agent, assign mechanic, publish to store)
7. Update PROJECT_SYSTEM_EXPLANATION.md with complete project documentation
instructions_for_ai_agent.design_philosophy: Industrial/tactical dark theme. Think: military command center meets e-commerce platform. Bold uppercase italic typography, glassmorphism cards, color-coded status system, neon accent glows.
instructions_for_ai_agent.reference_documentation: Read PROJECT_SYSTEM_EXPLANATION.md for full system architecture, database schema, and workflow diagrams.
